verdict: Ads are running but zero leads captured — tracking must come first.
narrative: In the last 28 days, $106.10 was spent on Meta advertising, producing 211 clicks and zero recorded leads. The root cause is that lead tracking was not live when spend was activated on September 3rd, so conversions cannot be measured or collected regardless of ad performance. Several foundational setup milestones — including landing pages, tracking, and CRM integration — are overdue, and those are being addressed now as the immediate priority. Once tracking is confirmed live, the ad signal from the past week will become readable and cost per lead will be reportable for the first time.
